definitions.explanation: A slow rate of speed or movement. Used for vehicles, machines, internet connections, and other things that operate at reduced speed. Often contrasted with {高速|こうそく} (high speed).

examples.japanese: {低速|ていそく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{走行|そうこう}→走行：14260_soukou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦データ{通信|つうしん}→データ通信：10747_deetatsuushin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{低速|ていそく}になって⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}られない→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: The data connection has slowed down and I can't watch videos.

examples.japanese: {低速|ていそく}⟦ギア→ギア：29982_gia⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}えて→切り替える：04239_kirikaeru⟧、⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧な⟦{坂道|さかみち}→坂道：08166_sakamichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{慎重|しんちょう}→慎重：03264_shinchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{下|くだ}った→下る：03913_kudaru⟧。
examples.english: I switched to low gear and carefully descended the steep hill.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a noun and as a ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧-modifier: {低速|ていそく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通信|つうしん}→通信：03514_tsuushin⟧ (low-speed connection). The opposite is ⟦{高速|こうそく}→高速：02749_kousoku⟧ (high speed). Common in automotive, technology, and mechanical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {低速|ていそく}⟦{走行|そうこう}→走行：14260_soukou⟧ (low-speed driving)
- {低速|ていそく}⟦{回線|かいせん}→回線：11094_kaisen⟧ (low-speed connection)
- {低速|ていそく}⟦モード→モード：11596_moodo⟧ (low-speed mode)
- {低速|ていそく}⟦ギア→ギア：29982_gia⟧ (low gear)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{高速|こうそく}→高速：02749_kousoku⟧ (high speed) is the antonym. ⟦{徐行|じょこう}→徐行：09215_jokou⟧ (moving slowly, crawling speed) specifically refers to very slow, cautious driving.
